status: parameterized development assumptions, not purchase or calibrated hardware specifications

stereo.optical_axes: x right, y down, z forward
stereo.model: ideal pinhole, two RGB render streams; NOT stereo matched depth
stereo.shutter: instantaneous ideal simulation; not a rolling shutter hardware model

lidar.model: RTX rotary idealized, uniform elevation; not exact hardware beam calibration
lidar.point_time_requirement: use annotator timestamps; do not fabricate common timestamps
lidar.hardware_mapping: OS0 REV8 FOV class only; local branded profiles are REV6/REV7, not a verified REV8 twin

imu.model: Isaac physics IMUSensor, ideal; noise not calibrated
imu.physical_preferred_source: Ouster REV8 embedded IAM-20685HP gyro+accelerometer; hardware rate differs, obtain calibration/firmware first
